notes:
You are copied on every email you send from HRMS. Offer and appointment letters, interview invites, document requests, payslips, birthday and anniversary wishes — whatever you send from the app or the web portal still goes out from the company mailbox with your name on it, and from now on your own address is on the Cc line as well, so the copy lands in your inbox and you can follow up from there. The compose screen says so before you send. If you are already the recipient, or you typed yourself into Cc, you are not added twice.

Sunday and comp-off duty now shows who decided. On the Admin rest-day list and on My Team, each claim carries who approved, rejected or changed it and when, with a history you can unfold wherever a decision was changed. A Super Admin's decision reads as "the Backend".

Questions inside course videos behave better: "Not now" puts a question aside with the video paused and it comes back when you press play, instead of popping straight back up. The in-app guide is updated to match.

For everybody else nothing changes.
